import importlib,importlib.util,json,sys,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv[1])
target=Path(sys.argv[1])
for name in ['k1_description','k1_common.paths','k1_common.clip_schema','k1_runtime.wbc','k1_runtime.k1_arm_ik','k1_teleop.teleop_mapping','k1m','k1m.gate','k1m.render','k1_utils.gait_gate','k1_chat.fleet']:
    m=importlib.import_module(name)
    assert Path(m.__file__).is_relative_to(target),(name,m.__file__)
    print('IMPORT_OK',name)
import k1_description as d
assert d.assets_dir().is_relative_to(target),d.assets_dir()
for name in [d.URDF,d.URDF_ZED,d.MJCF,d.MJCF_MJLAB,d.MJCF_MJLAB_ARMS,d.USD_MJLAB,d.USD_MJLAB_ARMS,d.USD_MJLAB_SOLID]:
    assert d.robot_file(name).is_file(),name
import mujoco
for name in [d.MJCF,d.MJCF_MJLAB,d.MJCF_MJLAB_ARMS]:
    model=mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path(str(d.robot_file(name)))
    assert model.nu==22,(name,model.nu)
from k1_runtime.k1_arm_ik import ArmIK
ArmIK()
from k1_chat import fleet
assert set(fleet.load()['robots'])=={'A1','A2','A3','B1','B2','B3'}
for name in ['k1_control.sim_bridge_node','k1_wbc.wbc_node','k1_locomotion.locomotion_node','k1_fleet_rviz.domain_relay','k1_kicking.tasks.kicking.kicking_env_cfg']:
    spec=importlib.util.find_spec(name)
    assert spec and Path(spec.origin).is_relative_to(target),(name,spec)
    print('MODULE_FOUND',name)
print('WHEEL_RUNTIME_OK')
